headline: From Mahoba to Shirdi, the PM Surya Ghar Scheme Brings a New Dawn to People's Lives
summary: Effects of the PM Surya Ghar free electricity scheme are becoming visible across India, according to IANS. The scheme provides free electricity to households.
why: PM Surya Ghar is a federal rooftop solar subsidy programme, and its uptake affects demand for residential solar installers and India's clean-energy targets.
